record.body:
## Problem

An effort has one `current-position`. Two chats on two phases of one effort overwrite each other, which pushes agents to split one area into several efforts.

## Approach

Decide at plan-phase. Likely: a position per phase, with execute-phase and the views updated to match.

## Exit criteria

Decide at plan-phase.

payload.title: Position per phase for parallel work
